thesis: Reddit is compounding revenue above 60% (Q2 2026 revenue $805M, +61%, eighth straight quarter over 60%) with 91% gross margins, 31% net margins, $2.8B net cash and no debt, yet the stock is down 41% over one year at ~21x FY2027 consensus EPS. The de-rating is entirely about traffic durability: 77.7M of 130.3M daily uniques are logged out and arrive largely via Google, US logged-in daily uniques grew just 1%, and management flagged that search referrals were choppy as Google shifts to AI answers. Monetisation is doing the work instead — global ARPU +36%, US ARPU +51% — and international (77.1M uniques at $2.26 ARPU versus $11.85 in the US) plus AI licensing renewals with Google and OpenAI are the upside levers. Speculative because nobody, including management, can yet quantify how much logged-out traffic survives the shift to AI search.

financials.eps_diluted: ~$2.64 (computed from $530M net income on ~201M diluted shares)
financials.cash: $2.79B (cash plus marketable securities at 2026-06-30, no debt)

drivers: Search referrals stabilise and logged-out daily uniques resume growth, removing the structural overhang
International ARPU ($2.26) closes meaningfully on US ARPU ($11.85) across a 77.1M-user base growing 28%
AI data licensing renews well above the reported ~$60M/year Google rate; Google and OpenAI deals reprice upward
FY2027 EPS reaches or exceeds ~$7 and the multiple re-rates to 33–38x
$1B buyback executed aggressively below the $157.57 average Q2 purchase price

base_case.assumptions: Revenue growth decelerates from 61% toward 35–40% through 2027 as the search-referral tailwind flattens, but advertising ARPU gains and international expansion keep compounding. FY2027 EPS lands at roughly $6.50–$7.00 on 25–28x — earnings delivery without any multiple re-rating. Consistent with TIKR consensus 2028 revenue of ~$5.5B. The midpoint near $180 coincides with the 200-day moving average ($170.20) and the pre-Q2-selloff trading range.

risks: Logged-out daily uniques turn negative as AI answer engines absorb query volume without linking through
US logged-in daily unique growth stays near zero, capping the highest-ARPU geography
Advertising revenue growth falls below 25%; ~90% gross margins make the operating leverage work in reverse
Google and OpenAI licensing renewals disappoint or lapse, removing the cleanest re-rating catalyst
Multiple compresses to 15–18x on flat-to-modest EPS; the 52-week low of $119.27 sits inside this band

catalysts.event: Q3 2026 earnings — company guide of $860–870M revenue and $385–395M adjusted EBITDA; the DAUq table matters more than the beat
Google and OpenAI AI data-licensing renewal decisions; Reddit has signalled it may not renew Google's reported ~$60M/year 2024 agreement on old terms
Perplexity AI and SerpApi anti-circumvention litigation milestones after the motion to dismiss was largely denied in July 2026
Q4 and FY2026 results plus FY2027 outlook — first full-year view of post-AI-search user economics
$1B share repurchase authorised February 2026; 1.5M shares bought in Q2 2026 at a $157.57 average, above the current price

key_risks: Search-referral dependency: 77.7M of 130.3M daily uniques are logged out and arrive substantially via Google, which is shifting to AI-generated answers
AI answer engines as substitutes: third-party tracking suggests Reddit's share of ChatGPT Search citations fell sharply in August 2026 (vendor estimate, not a company disclosure)
US user stagnation: US DAUq +6% and US logged-in DAUq +1%, so US revenue growth of 56% is almost entirely price-led
Advertising concentration and cyclicality: 95% of revenue is advertising, an early casualty in any downturn
Symmetric operating leverage: with ~90% gross margins and a fixed cost base, revenue misses flow to earnings at near-full rate
Multiple compression risk: the stock lost 41% in a year without a single quarterly miss, so re-rating can continue independently of results
Stock-based compensation of ~$101M per quarter (~12.5% of revenue) requires continuous buybacks to hold share count flat
Dual-class share structure concentrates voting control; content depends on unpaid volunteer moderators
